name: JavaScript Minifier
summary: Minify JavaScript by collapsing whitespace and stripping comments — locally.
description: Paste JavaScript to shrink it for size comparison or quick delivery. Optionally strip line and block comments while preserving strings and regex literals. Lightweight heuristic minifier — not Terser.

faqs.question: Is this Terser / Uglify?
faqs.answer: No. It collapses whitespace and can strip comments while keeping strings/regex intact. It does not rename variables or perform AST optimizations.

faqs.question: Are comments removed?
faqs.answer: Yes by default. Uncheck “Strip comments” to keep them.

faqs.question: Is my code uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Minification runs entirely in your browser.
